title: Translate and explain a foreign-language restaurant menu using Qwen on your phone
facebook: Ever tried ordering from a menu in a language you don't speak? Just point your phone at it and Qwen translates each dish, shows what ingredients are likely in it, and warns about common allergens. No more guessing! https://aiworldhq.com/article/translate-and-explain-any-restaurant-menu-with-qwen-on-your-phone #travelhacks #ai
